newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds slip but rises seen possible.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds slip but rises seen possible.

text.p: Danish bond prices eased in early trade on Tuesday but dealers said that sentiment remained enthusiastic despite low volume, and prices could recover.
"The positive tone appears to be intact even though turnover is not impressive," a dealer said.

At 0730 GMT the tone-setting seven percent government bond due 2007 was down 0.03 percent from Monday's close, to 106.40, yielding 6.14 percent. Its spread to the 10-year German bund was unchanged at 59 basis points.
The crown weakened slightly, to 3.8080 to the mark from Monday's 3.8075.
The six percent mortgage bond due 2026 was unchanged at 92.15.
The 5-10 year curved was seen continuing to flatten.
